description: PERMANENTLY delete a scheduled event from the brand's Discord server; Discord keeps no record of it. To call an event off but keep it in the server's history, cancel it instead (update_discord_event with status canceled). Call it WITHOUT confirm first: nothing is deleted and you get a sentence naming the event and how many people are interested. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

confirm.description: true only once the user agreed

discordServer.description: which Discord server (id or name) when the bot is in several

name: delete_discord_event
title: Delete a Discord event
